covered_report_window: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the U.S. market close on Thursday, July 30, 2026, plus companies reporting before the U.S. market open on Friday, July 31, 2026.
market_context_summary: U.S. market still open at scheduled run time. Major context: rebound after Microsoft strength, Meta disappointment, Fed hold/hawkish-rate backdrop, oil/geopolitical volatility, and intense scrutiny of AI capex before Apple/Amazon.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Exxon has the clearest positive setup because its own Q2 indicator update and higher crude/refining margins point to a materially stronger earnings bridge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Calendar sources show XOM BMO Jul 31 with EPS/revenue estimates around $3.56/$109.9B; Reuters-linked coverage said Exxon signaled about a $5B sequential earnings boost from oil and refining.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Higher liquids prices, improved refining margins, and resilient production/cash return commentary could clear the published bar.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: The stock was already up strongly in 2026, so merely confirming the bridge could trigger sell-the-news if oil reverses.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options detail not available in sourced data; positioning risk inferred from strong YTD move and commodity sensitivity.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Published preview/consensus estimates show a much higher earnings bar than Q1, but the company bridge appears supportive.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Chevron screens constructive because the market should focus on Q2 commodity/refining recovery and whether management sustains portfolio/capital-return confidence.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Digrin lists CVX BMO Jul 31 with EPS/revenue estimates near $5.62/$63.3B; Chevron IR confirms a Jul 31 earnings call; Q1 cash returns were $6.0B.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: A strong earnings rebound, operating execution, and continued cash-return discipline could support a positive reaction.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Any hesitation on projects, asset streamlining, or cash returns could offset the commodity tailwind.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options detail unavailable; reversal risk reflects commodity beta and sell-the-news risk after oil volatility.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: External previews point to sharply higher Q2 estimates; the setup depends on quality of earnings and guidance tone.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Reddit has a positive but fragile setup because the key metric is ad monetization and user growth against a high-growth platform narrative.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Digrin lists RDDT after close Jul 30 with EPS/revenue estimates near $0.97/$744.9M; social attention is structurally high but not treated as primary evidence.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: A clean ad-growth beat, stronger DAU/engagement, or confident AI/data licensing commentary could drive upside.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Valuation and crowding mean even a beat could fade if user growth or forward ad tone is not strong enough.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No sourced implied move found; platform retail attention raises two-way event risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Estimate availability is calendar-level in this run, so confidence is capped.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Amazon’s AWS acceleration is constructive, but capex and free-cash-flow scrutiny make the immediate post-earnings direction too two-sided for a stronger call.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Digrin lists AMZN AMC Jul 30 with EPS/revenue near $1.86/$200.2B; multiple previews say investors are focused on AWS growth, AI capex, and cash flow.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: AWS growth above expectations with disciplined capex and strong retail/ads could lift shares.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A higher capex outlook without clear monetization could overwhelm a revenue beat, as seen in broader hyperscaler reactions.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Investopedia reported options pricing implied roughly a 6% post-earnings move.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Analysts remained broadly bullish in previews, but the bar centers on AWS and spending discipline rather than headline EPS alone.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Cloudflare’s growth setup is interesting, but the premium multiple and need for guidance follow-through keep the consensus near neutral.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Digrin lists NET after close Jul 30 with EPS/revenue estimates near $0.27/$664.7M; MarketBeat preview cites the same Q2 EPS and revenue setup and FY guidance range.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Revenue acceleration, strong large-customer metrics, and raised guidance could produce upside.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A merely in-line report or cautious guide could compress the premium valuation.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No sourced implied move found; high-growth software valuation raises reversal risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q2 estimates appear aligned around $0.27 EPS and about $665M revenue; confidence capped by limited source breadth.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: AbbVie has solid evidence quality but only a modest directional edge because immunology growth must keep outrunning Humira erosion.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: AbbVie confirmed Jul 31 BMO timing; Digrin lists EPS/revenue estimates around $3.67/$17.1B; Q1 showed strong Skyrizi and Rinvoq growth while Humira continued to decline.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Skyrizi/Rinvoq strength, neuroscience growth, and maintained guidance could support relief upside.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Any pipeline, margin, or post-Humira transition caution could cap the reaction.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options detail unavailable; lower reversal risk reflects defensive profile, not a strong directional edge.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Zacks/TradingView preview cited consensus sales of $16.81B and EPS of $3.66, broadly near calendar estimates.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Apple’s expected iPhone strength is largely visible, while pull-forward, memory-cost, and leadership-transition questions cap the directional edge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Digrin lists AAPL after close Jul 30 with EPS/revenue near $1.93/$110.8B; MarketWatch/FactSet cited revenue growth to about $109B and iPhone revenue growth as the key metric.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: A stronger iPhone/services print and benign product-margin commentary could lift shares.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Demand pull-forward, memory-cost pressure, or weak forward commentary could sink the stock despite a headline beat.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Barron’s cited an options-implied move of about 3%, with recent Apple earnings moves historically muted.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Published previews describe strong expectations; the bar likely requires more than a standard beat.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Coinbase has the clearest bearish operating setup because trading volumes and transaction revenue look weak, but reversal risk is high due to crypto and regulatory squeeze potential.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Digrin lists COIN AMC Jul 30 with EPS/revenue near -$0.12/$1.3B; IBD and Barron’s previews cite lower trading volumes, expected revenue decline, and a loss versus a large year-ago profit.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: A crypto rebound, stronger subscription/stablecoin revenue, or Clarity Act optimism could squeeze the stock higher.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Weak consumer/institutional trading and restructuring costs could pressure the stock if guidance lacks relief.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options detail unavailable; high beta, retail interest, and regulatory catalyst risk drive high reversal risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Published previews cite a sharply lower bar versus year-ago results, but not necessarily a low enough bar to offset volume weakness.
